voices.advisor: Elderly British military advisor, warm and wise, slightly gravelly, calm measured delivery, reassuring
voices.varek: Old grizzled field marshal, very deep gravelly voice, slow, stoic and commanding
voices.ysolde: Stern aristocratic woman general in her forties, cold, crisp, precise and commanding
voices.quill: Portly sly quartermaster, nasal and amused, quick merchant patter
voices.oren: Young eager cavalry captain in his twenties, bright, boyish and overconfident
voices.hask: Huge bearded northern warlord, booming deep voice, rough accent, laughs easily
voices.imre: Calm sharp-witted woman tactician, low even voice, dry and understated

advisor.welcome: Welcome to the war table, Commander. The world is wide, the maps are blank, and every inch of it is ours for the taking.
advisor.deploy: Plant our flag and pour in the troops. Spread too thin and the vultures will pick us apart.
reinforce: Fresh regiments off the boats, Commander. Send them where the fighting is.
New recruits have arrived. Put them where the enemy can see them.
More men for the cause. Strengthen the border, not the barracks.
advisor.attack_hint: Select one of our lands, then click the enemy you mean to crush.
advisor.vacate_warn: Careful. March them all out and that land stands empty. Any jackal next door could stroll right in.
unplaced: We have regiments idling on the docks. Unplaced men go home, and I will not have it.
Commander, there are still men standing on the docks. Place them, or lose them.
Some of our recruits have no orders yet. Unplaced troops go home at the seal.
sealed: Orders sealed. Now we see who flinches.
Sealed and sent. No taking it back now, Commander.
The couriers are riding. Whatever happens next, we chose it.
Signed, sealed, and out of our hands. I do love this part.
There. Our orders are in. Now we wait for the others to show their hand.
reveal: There it is. Every army on the map, marching at once. Glorious.
And there they go! Every column on the map, all at once.
The orders are open. Let us see who guessed right.
Look at them all. Half of those arrows are aimed at somebody's mistake.
Everyone moves at once. Somebody is about to have a very bad afternoon.
walkin_us: A walk-in! They left the gates wide open and we marched straight through. Plant the flag!
They left the door open and we walked right in. Splendid!
Not a soul defending it. Thank you kindly.
Empty! Oh, that is careless of them. Ours now.
walkin_them: Blast! They walked straight into a land we left empty.
Confound it! We left the door open, and they walked right in.
They strolled into an empty land of ours. Lesson learned, I hope.
An empty land is an invitation, Commander. They accepted.
capture: It is ours! Raise the colours!
The flag goes up. Another one for the map.
We have it! The men will drink well tonight.
hold: Our garrison held. Let them break their teeth on our walls.
They came, they bled, they went home. We hold!
The line held, Commander. Good men, those.
Repulsed! Send them home with their tails between their legs.
lost_land: We have lost ground there, Commander. We will take it back with interest.
We have lost it, Commander. A bitter blow.
The land has fallen. We will be back for it.
Gone. Mark it on the map, and mark who took it.
advisor.region: The whole region flies our colours. Its riches will swell our ranks every round.
advisor.cards: We hold a matching set of cards. Cash them in and call up the regiments.
advisor.final: Final round, Commander! Only land counts now. Throw in everything. Leave nothing in the barracks.
leader: We lead the war. Every crown at this table wants our head. Let them come.
We are out in front, Commander. Expect company.
behind: We are falling behind. Fortune favours the bold, Commander. Attack!
The others are pulling ahead. We need land, and quickly.
enemy_out: One less rival for the throne. Their lands are ripe for the taking.
Another banner falls. The table grows smaller.
One rival down. The rest will be nervous now.
advisor.defeat: We are beaten, Commander. Even empires fall. But what a war it was.
advisor.victory: Victory! The world bows to you, Commander. Magnificent. Utterly magnificent.
advisor.dug_in: Lands we hold dig in. Dug-in troops never march, so they keep a land safe while the rest go conquering.
advisor.surge: A clean breakthrough! With men to spare, we can surge on to the next land.
advisor.plan: Here is what I would do, Commander.
press: They are breaking! Press the attack!
Forward! Do not give them a moment to breathe!
Press on! We have them now.
retreat: Sound the retreat! Save the men for another day.
Pull them back, Commander. Live to fight another round.
Fall back in good order. There is no shame in it.
reserves: Send in the reserves! Every last man!
Bring up the reserves! Throw them in!
Every man we have, Commander. Now is the moment.
cut_off: We are cut off, Commander. There is no retreat. Fight or die.
Nowhere to fall back to, Commander. It is this field or nothing.
No retreat from here. The men know it. So do I.
opening_bad: A bloody opening. Fall back now and save the men, or press on and pray.
That went poorly. Cut our losses, or double down?
They are giving as good as they get. Your call, Commander.
An ugly start. The dice are not with us yet.
opening_good: A glorious opening! One more push and the land is ours.
A fine start! They are wavering, Commander.
Their line is buckling. Keep at them!
Good shooting! The day is ours if we hold our nerve.
maneuver: The dust has settled, Commander. March the men up to the front before the next assault.
The guns have gone quiet. Shift the men forward while we can.
A moment's peace. Use it. March the reserves up to the border.
Regroup, Commander. Idle soldiers in the rear win nothing.
melee: A melee, Commander! Every army piling in at once. Steady on every front!
Three armies, one field. Chaos, Commander. Glorious chaos.
Everyone has come to the same party. Keep your head down.
advisor.draft_roll: Every commander throws a die. The highest roll claims first, and so on round the table.
advisor.draft_first: Fortune smiles, Commander. We choose first. Take the land that matters most.
advisor.draft_pick: Our pick, Commander. Claim a land.
cards_seized: Their war chest is ours, Commander. Every card they held now fights for us.
Their war chest is ours! Every last card.
scramble: The defenders are finished. Now the victors turn on each other. Every man for himself!
The garrison is gone, and now the wolves turn on each other!
Nobody holds it yet. Now the victors fight for the spoils!
cash_us: Cards turned in, Commander. Fresh regiments are marching to the front.
The cards are in. Fresh troops, courtesy of the war office.
Cashed in! Call up the regiments.
cash_them: They have turned in their cards. Expect a flood of fresh troops across the border.
They have cashed in their cards. Mind the border, Commander.
Fresh troops for the enemy. Brace yourself.
orders: The troops are placed, Commander. Now, where do we strike?
The recruits are in position. Now choose our targets.
The men are ready. Point them at something worth taking.
Placements done. Now the interesting part. Who do we hit?
surges: Now the breakthroughs. Every surge charges on at once!
The breakthroughs charge on! Hold on to your hat.
Here come the surges. Steady now.
upset_win: Against all odds! I will not pretend I expected that.
Well, I never! The dice owed us one.
That should not have worked. But it did! Marvellous!
A miracle, Commander. Do not get used to it.
upset_loss: Impossible! We had them beaten three times over!
Of all the rotten luck. Those odds were ours.
Blast those dice! That was a certainty on paper.
Sometimes the dice simply hate us, Commander. Today is one of those days.
Well. That was an outrage. Remember it, and move on.
close_win: Taken with a single man standing. Close, Commander. Far too close.
One man left, and the land is ours. Give that fellow a medal.
close_hold: One soldier left on the walls, and he held! Remarkable.
By the skin of our teeth, Commander. But we hold.
capital_choose: Choose our capital, Commander. Somewhere safe, somewhere central. It pays well, and it fights hard.
Every empire needs a seat of government. Pick ours wisely.
capital_move: The court has fled, Commander. Name a new capital, or leave it where it landed.
Our government has moved in rather a hurry. Choose a proper home for it.
capital_taken: Their capital is ours! Plunder the treasury!
We have taken their seat of government! Half their cards, and a city full of recruits.
Their crown has fallen! Loot the vaults, lads!
capital_lost: Our capital has fallen! The treasury is plundered.
They have taken the capital, Commander. The court is fleeing.
A black day. Our capital is in enemy hands.
fortune_us: Fortune, favour us now! Throw again!
Once more, lads! Fortune is with us!
That never happened, Commander. Throw again!
fortune_them: They have called on Fortune. The cheek of it.
They have bought themselves another throw. Steady, Commander.
fortune_gained: Fortune owes us one, Commander. The dice have been cruel.
The dice have robbed us once too often. Fortune is in our debt.
A favour banked. Spend it when the dice turn on us.

varek.greet: Grand Marshal Varek. I have buried a hundred generals. You will be a hundred and one.
attack: Advance, and do not stop until it is ours.
lose: A setback. They will pay for it in blood.
Bury the dead. We go again.
walkin: You left it empty. I merely accepted the invitation.
An open gate is an invitation. I accepted.
You forgot to leave a guard. I did not forget to notice.
varek.eliminated: My war is over. Remember the old soldier.
varek.victory: The world is mine. It always was.
retreat: Fall back. Regroup. We return at dawn.
Withdraw in good order. Discipline.
Enough. Pull them back.
reserves: Bring up the reserves. End this.
Commit the reserve. Finish it.
Every man forward. Now.
claim: This ground is mine. Dig in.
cash: Fresh regiments. Send them to the front.
The war office sends its compliments. And its regiments.
capital_took: Your capital is mine. Your treasury too.
The seat of your government now flies *my* colours.
A capital is only stone. You should have held it.
capital_lost: They have taken my capital. They will not keep it.
The capital falls. The war does not.
Move the court. We fight on.
taunt: I see your border, Commander. It is thin.
My columns are marching. I would dig in, if I were you.
You have something of mine. I am coming to collect.
Brace yourself. This one will *hurt*.
fortune: Fortune owes me. I am collecting.

ysolde.greet: Viceroy Ysolde. Every land at this table will fly my banner. Guard your doors.
attack: March. And do not come back without victory.
win: They were never going to hold.
lose: You will pay for that. Dearly.
You have made an enemy today, Commander.
walkin: An empty fort is an insult to its owner. I have corrected it.
You left it undefended. How generous.
An empty province. How very careless.
ysolde.eliminated: This is not the end of my house.
retreat: Withdraw. For now.
Fall back. I will remember this.
Withdraw. We choose the next battle.
reserves: Send everything. I do not lose.
Send the guard. All of it.
Reinforce. I do not accept defeat.
claim: I will take this one. Remember who chose first.
This one is mine. Mark it.
cash: My reserves have arrived. Now you will see an army.
The treasury is open. Raise the regiments.
capital_took: Your court has fled. Your treasury, has not.
A pretty city. I will rename it.
capital_lost: They dare to sit in *my* capital?
My court moves. My army does not forget.
You have taken my capital. Now I will take *everything*.
taunt: Your border is weak, Commander. I can see it from here.
In my country, we do not knock.
Look east, Commander. Winter is coming for you.
I hope you enjoyed that land. You will *not* keep it.
fortune: Fortune serves me, like everyone else.

quill.greet: Governor Quill, of the Company. Everything has its price, and I intend to buy the world.
attack: An investment opportunity, lads. Go and collect.
Right lads. Go and repossess it!
There is money in that valley. Fetch it.
walkin: Unattended property? Mine, by right of possession.
quill.eliminated: Bankrupt. Well, it was lovely doing business.
quill.victory: Tally it up. The Company owns the lot.
retreat: Cut our losses, lads. Back to the ships.
Pull out, lads. The market has turned.
Sell! Sell!
reserves: Double the investment! Send the reserves!
Throw in our capital! All of it!
Double down, gentlemen!
claim: A fine piece of property. I will take it.
Prime real estate. I'll take it.
cash: A fine return on the investment. More men, at once!
Cashing in my chips. With interest.
capital_took: What a lovely capital. And such *generous* vaults.
The Company thanks you for your contribution.
capital_lost: My counting house! Somebody stop them!
They have robbed the treasury! Pack the ledgers, we are moving.
A temporary cash flow problem. Temporary!
taunt: Nothing personal, Commander. Just business.
I have an offer you cannot refuse. My army.
Your lands are under new management.
Let us call it a merger, shall we?
fortune: I would like a refund, please!

oren.greet: Captain Oren of the Hussars! First war, but I have a very fast horse!
attack: Come on, boys! Last one there buys the drinks!
win: Did you see that? Did everyone see that?
lose: Wait, that was not supposed to happen!
That is, hm. That is not ideal.
walkin: Nobody home? Do not mind if I do!
oren.eliminated: I will be back. With more horses.
oren.victory: I won? I won! Somebody tell my mother!
retreat: Retreat! Tactical retreat! Very tactical!
Back! Back! Regroup! Look dashing!
Strategic withdrawal! It is a real thing!
reserves: Everybody! Everybody charge!
Send everyone! Even the cooks!
Bring the whole regiment!
claim: Ooh, that one! I call that one!
cash: Reinforcements! Oh, this is going to be fun!
More soldiers! This is the best day ever!
capital_took: I took your capital! Wait until I write home!
Your capital! Is it mine? It is mine!
Ha! A whole capital! With a palace!
capital_lost: My capital?! Oh, Mother is going to be furious.
They took my capital? I was using that!
Right. New capital. Nobody panic. I'm not panicking!
taunt: Hello, neighbour! Coming through!
Ready or not, here I come!
You look like you need a good charge, Commander!
I have a very fast horse, and it is pointed at you!
fortune: Do-over! That one did not count!

hask.greet: Commodore Hask, the Old Bear! Bring me your best, little general, and I will sink it!
attack: Haaa! Break them! Burn their boats!
Up and at them! The Bear is hungry!
win: That is how the *Bear* does it!
lose: Bah! They will pay for that one!
Hrmph. Patch the hull and go again.
walkin: Empty? The Bear says thank you!
hask.eliminated: Bah! Pour me a drink. I am done.
hask.victory: The Bear rules land and sea! Ha ha ha!
retreat: Back to the ships! I will be back for you!
Hard about! Back to the ships!
Fall back, lads! Live to plunder another day!
reserves: More! Send more! The Bear is hungry!
All hands! Everybody in!
Send the whole fleet! Ha!
claim: Ha! Plant my flag there, lads!
cash: More lads for the Bear! Ha!
Fresh crew for the Bear! Ha ha!
capital_took: Your capital! Loot the treasury, lads! Ha ha!
The Bear sits on *your* throne now!
What a prize! Hoist my colours!
capital_lost: They have taken my capital! Argh! To arms!
My hall! My beer! They will pay!
Bah! A capital is just a building. The Bear is still here!
taunt: I am coming for you, little general!
Hide your ships and lock your doors!
The Bear smells your border, and it smells weak!
Run! Or do not. It is more *fun* if you don't.
fortune: Throw the bones again, lads! Ha!
The sea owes the Bear a better wind!

imre.greet: Admiral Imre. I have already read your plan.
attack: They are *exactly* where I expected. Strike.
lose: A variance. It will even out.
walkin: You moved. I did not. That was the whole trick.
Empty. I had counted on that.
retreat: The odds have turned. We withdraw.
The odds have shifted. Withdraw.
Preserve the fleet. Fall back.
reserves: Commit the reserve. Now.
Now comes the reserve.
All of it. The margin matters.
claim: That one. You were about to take it, were you not?
cash: I have been saving these. Now they matter.
capital_took: Your capital. I have had it marked since round one.
The seat of your power. Now the seat of mine.
Your treasury was poorly defended. I corrected that :).
capital_lost: My capital has fallen. Irritating.
A setback. The court relocates. The plan continues.
Well played. It will not happen twice.
taunt: I have already seen your next move, Commander.
You are predictable. That is not a compliment.
I found your weakest border.
Check.
